chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.titan_whale: This heartbeat was kept in trust, from the depths of the earth.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.teach: Teach me how to make things again.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.a_menu.ward: Weave my heartbeat ward again. (eight shell scraps)
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_deja:
Ah, you were by the pack. ...No. I only feel I have met you before.
The tools remember. The owner, less so. Take these notes; copy what matters.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_first:
...Come to look at the pack? The tools remember. The owner, less so.
Call me the traveling artisan. There was no name written anywhere in the pack.
I can stitch road gear. I can hone a blade. ...But I do not keep what I am asked for very long. If it matters, copy it into your notes.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_first_bla:
...Come to ask about blades? The whale chaser sent you.
Call me the traveling artisan. There was no name written anywhere in the pack. The tools remember. The owner, less so.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_notes:
Lost them? ...There should be another copy tucked in the pack somewhere. Here.
Tools get lost. Notes get lost. There is no harm in more copies.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_ready:
You carry your pack well. ...Body, blade, provisions: you are ready for the road.
When the chain comes down, do not hesitate. Hesitation makes a pack heavy.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_some:
Half-ready, by the look. No need to hurry. The whale will not wait, but it will not hurry you either.
What you lack is usually within reach: beside the road, in the Cleft Shell, under the bones.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_ward:
The ward came unwoven. ...I need shell scraps. You brought them.
It is woven again. One a day, no more. The thread-hand says so.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1a_ward_ask:
To weave a ward again I need shell scraps, for the trouble. They lie beside the road, in the cave, under the bones.
And one a day at most. If you are in a hurry, count your thread first.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1p_teach:
The way of it? ...Shell scraps, with bone chips, make whetstones too. Hardtack and salve as well. It is in your notes.
Lay it out on a workbench as often as it takes for your hands to remember.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1t_blade_sho:
You saw the broken sword. On the plinth. ...Do you remember how the grip was wound?
That is the way I teach it. ...No. I only feel I taught it. My hands say so.
An iron sword you can make at a workbench. Hone it on a rock whetstone: shell scraps, a bone chip and flint. I copied the way into your notes. Do not swing it unhoned.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1t_blade_tel:
A blade? ...I saw a broken sword. Deep in the Cleft Shell. When, I do not remember.
It lay on a plinth. Someone meant to come back for it, I suppose. Go and look. I will teach you the making after.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch1t_ward_weav:
Shell-ward thread. A good one. It is made to slacken in time with a beat.
I will weave it. Once, when you would fall, it will take the blow on your shoulder. Used, it unravels and is gone. When it does, bring it back. Shell scraps will do for my trouble.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch1_diary_:
...Let me see that diary.
So the cart's owner never made it here. The handwriting is... no, never mind. I've simply seen a hand like it before.
Thank you for looking.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch1_errand:
You'll lend a hand? That's a help.
Go and look at two of the stones piled along the road, to see whether they've fallen.
And some firewood against the night. Eight logs will do.

Thank you. Put the firewood out at the board by the lodge.
...And try not to count the stones too carefully.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch1p_artis:
Have you seen the one with a pack spread out by the cart track? A traveling artisan. ...My hands remember whose pack that was. The way the needle goes in, too.
About the broken sword, ask them. Honing a blade, stitching road gear, too. The owner, I still cannot recall.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch1t_s_rea:
You look different. Iron, a blade, a shield. ...Truly like the one from that morning.
I feel I have seen this hand before. The writing on the pages you brought back. ...Now where was it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch1t_shiel:
Let me tell you about the night of footsteps. ...I was still small then.
All night the ground boomed beyond the hill. In the morning a traveller came back over it, a shield clutched to their chest, a bundle of hardtack on their back. Three great claw marks crossed the shield.

They rested a little, then went to look at the sky again. That was the last of them.
...Watching the way you walk reminds me of that morning. Take a shield. Provisions too. If you mean to come back.
Is there something I can do?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1_c_aft:
You stopped that heart. ...The song rang with one verse missing, didn't it. I heard it too.
The whale has gone back to the sky. You truly took in what was kept for you from the deep earth.

Don't you smell the sea? There's salt in the night wind.
...The sea is next, I expect. I'll go ahead to the shore.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1_c_dia:
The cart owner's diary. Let me see.
...I can't read it. No, I can, but I don't want to. The hand looks like one I know.
I'll not say whose.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1_c_hus:
The song stopped, did it. ...I've chased it a long time and never once heard it go silent.
Beneath that shadow, even the whale holds its breath.

Then what I've been chasing wasn't the highest thing after all.
...When the chain comes down, grab it without hesitating. I won't ask you to do it for me.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1_c_why:
My reason, is it. ...Nothing worth telling.
I was a man of the sea, once. That's all.

There was a ship. Not a ship of the sky, a ship of the sea.
One night on deck I heard that song. The captain said nothing and turned the wheel toward it.

When I came to, I'd been washed up on a beach. Only me.
They say the captain's log drifted onto that back along with the ship.
...If you ever stand on it, look for it for me.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1p_c_al:
Your pack looks heavy. ...A good weight.
When the chain comes down, do not hesitate. I have seen plenty fall by hesitating. You do not have that look.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1p_c_no:
Standing there empty-handed, looking at the sky. ...I hope you will not regret it when the chain comes.
Have you looked around the cart by the road? Someone's hands are still in it.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1p_c_so:
Half-ready, by the look. Not bad.
The whale will not wait, but it will not hurry you either. What you lack is probably still lying beside the road.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1t_c_ir:
You smell of iron. ...It suits you.
I feel that traveller stood under the chain just like that. ...No. I only heard the story. I cannot have seen it.
Next, a blade. Ask the traveling artisan. They said they saw a broken sword.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch1t_c_pa:
You found a page down the pit? ...Twenty-four iron. A tidy sort.
Ore smelts into iron in a furnace. Charcoal or coal, either burns. ...The chain will not wait, but it will not hurry you either.
item.skyabyss.bone_chip.desc: A chip of pale bone. For whetstones and hardtack
item.skyabyss.ch1.whale_link.lore: A link of chain fallen from the sky. It still trembles faintly.
item.skyabyss.hare_quill.desc: A needle of bone spine. Material for travel arrows
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ch1_diary: A page from the diary of the cart owner.
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ch1_trace: A page left behind where people once were. I cannot tell whose hand it is.
item.skyabyss.moss_salve.desc: Cures slowness and mends wounds for a short while.
item.skyabyss.road_hardtack.desc: Travel bread baked hard with bone meal. Grants absorption for sixty seconds.
item.skyabyss.rock_shell_scrap.desc: A shard of grey-blue shell. Material for road gear
item.skyabyss.rock_shell_thread.desc: A thread from behind the shell. Material for the Stone Whale heartbeat ward
item.skyabyss.rock_whetstone.desc: Use it to hone your blade for twenty minutes (+1.5 attack).
item.skyabyss.sentry_tally.desc: A notched bone tally. The old sentry carried it for someone who never came to claim it.
item.skyabyss.whale_chaser_mark.lore: The mark of a traveller with iron, blade and shield. A bone chip on a cord, tied the way Isana ties things.
item.skyabyss.whale_road_armor.desc: Travelling gear with rock-shell pauldrons sewn on. It holds your footing.
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cairn_rounds.body:
Not one of the cairns had fallen, though there must have been wind and rain.

But each was stacked a little differently, some wound to the right, some to the left. They were not the work of a single hand.

Who keeps mending the waymarks?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cairn_rounds.title: Rounds of the Cairns
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cleft_cave.body:
Along the back wall of the cave ran a line of cracks carved in the shape of amber eyes. Someone had tested a blade here. The scars were fresh, and whoever held that blade had not come back.

On the plinth, a tally had once sat. Who took it?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cleft_cave.title: The Cleft Shell
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cold_door.body:
Deep in the Bone Pit, past a stone door that opens only to one who wears iron, lay a small room of ice. On its tablet, in an old hand:

"The wind on the back is cold. It reaches the bone. Climb wearing iron. Iron remembers the cold."

In the frost at its foot was a single fresh footprint, facing toward the door.
lore.skyabyss.ch1.cold_door.title: The Inscription Behind the Cold Door
lore.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.body:
On the hilltop stood a stone plinth and a brass tube. Through it, in a break in the dusk clouds, I saw an edge darker than the clouds.

The edge was moving, slowly, at an even pace. Only the edge was visible, and the edge alone was as large as a hill.

What could I have compared it to?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.title: The Lookout Hill
lore.skyabyss.ch1.road_cairns.body:
No two cairns were the same height, yet every one pointed the same way. At the end of the road stood a low-roofed shrine, its candle burnt out.

Behind the seventh stone, one line was scratched with a nail: "Up to here, we could walk."

Did they not walk any farther?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.road_cairns.title: The Stones Leading Under the Sky
lore.skyabyss.ch1.sentry.body:
At night an armored skeleton walked the foot of the hill, circling the same path. By morning it was gone.

Folded deep in the chest of the fallen bones was a single page. It said only: "Do not leave your post."

Who set it to watch, and over what?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.sentry.title: Bones That Walk at Night
lore.skyabyss.ch1.small_wrongs.body:
Each day, one thing was different. The calls of birds broke off. A bell sounded from the wrong direction. A line of footprints had one step too many.

I tried to count them, and stopped. It felt as though the more I counted, the more there would be.

Is it the world that is wrong? Or is it me?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.small_wrongs.title: Small Wrongs
lore.skyabyss.ch1.song_chamber.body:
One stone at the foot of the bell sank without a sound. Beneath a ladder lay a small room. Five pillars of differing height stood along the wall, from the lowest to the tallest.

The "five" in the counting song may not have been a number. It may have been an order of heights.
lore.skyabyss.ch1.song_chamber.title: The Room Beneath the Bell
lore.skyabyss.ch1.song_stones.body:
Each of the five stones rang at a different pitch when struck. When I struck them in the order of the small cairns beside them, from the lowest, a bell answered once, late, from far away.

The bell at the lodge, though no one was ringing it.

Did the stones know the rest of the counting song?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.song_stones.title: Five Song Stones
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_altar.body:
It was only three stones piled one upon another. On it lay a crust of dry bread and an old bell, its clapper pulled out.

Letters had been cut into the back of the stand: "Do not ring it. You would be calling."

Calling what?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_altar.title: The Small Altar
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_cart.body:
One wheel had come off and lay far away in the grass. Four scratches ran across the bed of the cart, as if raked by claws, spaced too wide for any beast.

A page was wedged between the floorboards: "Do not flee with heavy loads. The lighter the thing, the farther it travels."

What were they fleeing?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_cart.title: The Fallen Cart
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_pack.body:
A pack lay with its mouth open. Inside were provisions and a folded map. The map showed only roads; not one place had a name.

A page lay flat at the bottom of the pack: "I gave my destination no name. If I did, it would remember me."

Who feared being remembered?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_pack.title: The Abandoned Pack
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_ring.body:
Charcoal remained inside the ring of stones, white at the tips and black at the root, as if someone had walked away without putting out the fire.

A torn page was weighted beside it with a stone. All I could read was: "From the third day on, I stopped counting."

What had been counted?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_ring.title: The Ring of Stones
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_well.body:
The water of the well did not reflect the sky. Though clouds were passing, a clear blue showed all the way to the bottom.

As I peered in, a page tied to a rope slid down toward me: "Water does not come from above. It comes from below."

Who had tied the rope?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trace_well.title: The Well Too Blue
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.body:
On the plinth deep in the Cleft Shell lay an iron sword, snapped at the root, its grip bound tight with cloth. The way it was wound was like the way your own hands wind things.

On the plinth's edge, one line scratched with a nail: "Swung it unhoned. So it broke."

Lifted, the sword fell apart like sand. How many years had it waited there?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.title: The Broken Sword
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.body:
At the bottom of a pack deep in the pit lay a page wrapped in oilcloth. The hand was hurried and ran in places.

"Twenty-four iron. Breastplate and leggings first. The wind on the back cuts to the bone. You cannot climb the chain bare-handed."

In the margin, one more line: "Same as before, up to here. Next time, do not hesitate."

Whose hand is this? That it looks familiar must be nothing.
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.title: The Page in the Pit
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.body:
When the storyteller was small, there was a night when the ground boomed beyond the hill until dawn. In the morning a traveller came back over it, a shield clutched to their chest, hardtack on their back. Three great claw marks crossed the shield.

They rested a little, went to look at the sky again, and were never seen after.

The storyteller said: "Watching the way you walk reminds me of that morning."
lore.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.title: The Shield on the Night of Footsteps
lore.skyabyss.ch1.traveler_diary.body:
The cart owner's handwriting grew thinner as the diary went on.

"East, toward the bell. A voice singing "don't look up" mixes with the wind. I walk counting my footprints. The count is wrong. There is always one more than my own."

I stopped at the handwriting. The long downstrokes, the angle of the flicks. I had seen this hand somewhere.

Who wrote this diary?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.traveler_diary.title: The Cart Owner's Diary
lore.skyabyss.ch1.whale_hush.body:
The sky fell quiet. The animals, the wind, and that low song all went silent at once.

It was not that we were afraid. A great thing had held its breath beneath something greater.

When the shadow passed, the song came back a little late. What could silence that?
lore.skyabyss.ch1.whale_hush.title: The Day the Song Stopped
message.skyabyss.ch1.aftermath.storytell: ...The song rang with a verse missing, didn't it. What is kept in trust must one day be returned. Don't ask me to whom.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_bone_cac: A heap of bones, gathered by something that meant to carry them off.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_bone_pit: Two enormous ribs jut from the ground like a gate. A cold wind rises from below.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_cart_tra: Where the ruts end, a pack has been spread out.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_cleft_sh: A damp wind comes out of the crack in the rock.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_diary_sp: A stone seat and a cold fire. Someone sat here and wrote.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_lookout: On the high ground stand a stone plinth and a brass tube.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_lost_car: Hollows of footprints lead away from beneath the cart, one step at a time.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_road_cai: A low cairn, with an arrow of stones pointing at the sky.
This cairn is a little taller than the last. The arrow points the same way.
A mossy cairn. The arrow ends under the clouds.
A single nail scratch at the root of the cairn.
The stones lead under the sky.
This cairn alone is on the verge of collapse, as if many hands had touched it.
A shrine at the end of the road. The candle has burnt out.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_song_sto: A mossy stone with a small cairn beside it. It looks as if it would ring if struck.
A mossy stone with a small cairn beside it. It looks as if it would ring if struck.
A mossy stone with a small cairn beside it. It looks as if it would ring if struck.
A mossy stone with a small cairn beside it. It looks as if it would ring if struck.
A mossy stone with a small cairn beside it. It looks as if it would ring if struck.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_trace_al: A small altar of three stacked stones. An offering of dry bread and a bell with no clapper.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_trace_ca: Charcoal remains in the ring of stones, white only at the tips.
A fallen cart. Four scratches rake the boards, as if by claws.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_trace_pa: A pack with its mouth open. The map inside has not one place name.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.ch1_trace_we: The bottom of the well is bluer than the sky.
message.skyabyss.ch1.arrive.song_chamber: The bell rang one verse lower.
message.skyabyss.ch1.beat.chain: Far above, a chain rang. After a while a ring of stone dropped at my feet, larger than my palm, and cold.
message.skyabyss.ch1.beat.dust: Though the sky is clear, a fine dry stone dust sifts down from above. It smells very old.
message.skyabyss.ch1.beat.shadow: Under a cloudless noon sky, a vast shadow crossed the ground, slowly, and only the ground.
message.skyabyss.ch1.cache.found: You pick something usable from under the bones.
message.skyabyss.ch1.cave.sword: On the plinth at the back lies a broken iron sword.
message.skyabyss.ch1.hush.end: The shadow has gone. A chain clinks, and the whale begins to move again.
message.skyabyss.ch1.hush.mid: Something is passing above the clouds. The whale knows it.
message.skyabyss.ch1.hush.start: The song stopped dead. The wind and the birds hold their breath.
message.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.edge:
I look through the tube. Between the dusk clouds, an edge darker than the clouds.
It moves slowly, toward the %s.
message.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.seen: The edge is gone, beyond the clouds.
message.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.size: There is nothing to compare it to. And still, it is far too large.
message.skyabyss.ch1.lookout.wait: Only clouds drift by. I should look again at dusk.
message.skyabyss.ch1.nook.bed: A bed has been set out at the lodge.
message.skyabyss.ch1.oddity.bell: A bell sounded, from the opposite direction to the lodge.
message.skyabyss.ch1.oddity.cold: My breath shows white. At midday, for the space of a single breath.
message.skyabyss.ch1.oddity.quiet: ...Not a single call can be heard. No birds, no insects.
message.skyabyss.ch1.oddity.step: There is one footprint too many.
message.skyabyss.ch1.pit.cold_open: The iron takes the cold. The stone door grinds back.
message.skyabyss.ch1.pit.cold_shut: The stone door is cold as ice. Your fingers stick to it.
message.skyabyss.ch1.pit.pack: At the bottom of the pack, a page wrapped in oilcloth. Iron and torches, neatly set out.
message.skyabyss.ch1.pit.pack_empty: The pack is empty now. Only a copy of the page is still tucked inside.
message.skyabyss.ch1.pit.pack_hint: An old pack lies here. Try touching it
message.skyabyss.ch1.plate.hint: Each stone rings as many times as it has candles.
message.skyabyss.ch1.plate.n3: The stone rang three times. Iron groaned in the deep.
message.skyabyss.ch1.plate.open: The iron grate in the deep slowly rose.
message.skyabyss.ch1.plate.wrong: The stone began to ring, then fell silent.
message.skyabyss.ch1.sentry.page: From deep inside the fallen bones came the sound of paper rubbing.
message.skyabyss.ch1.sentry.tally: In the old sentry's grip was a notched bone tally.
message.skyabyss.ch1.stone.answer: Far away, a bell answered once.
message.skyabyss.ch1.stone.chamber: A stone at the foot of the bell sank without a sound.
message.skyabyss.ch1.stone.done: The stone no longer rings. ...The bell still lingers in my ears.
message.skyabyss.ch1.stone.n2: Two. The stone rang a little higher.
message.skyabyss.ch1.stone.wrong: The stone began to ring, and fell silent.
message.skyabyss.ch1.trail.call: Far off, at the bottom of the sky, a low song begins.
message.skyabyss.ch1.trail.mark: You received the Whale Chaser's Mark
message.skyabyss.recipe.locked: You do not know how to make this yet. Open your wayfarer's notes, or ask the traveling artisan.
message.skyabyss.whetstone.used: You honed your blade. It will bite for twenty minutes.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_cairns.done: "Not a one had fallen? ...Then that is all right."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_cairns.round.jou:
The storyteller asked: "Go and see whether the stones piled along the road have fallen. Two will be enough."
The cairns stand beside the road and near the traces of travelers.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_cairns.summary: Look over two of the cairns along the road and at the traces of travelers.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_cairns.title: Rounds of the Cairns
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_firewood.done: "Thank you. Now the fire can last through the night."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_firewood.summary: Hand eight logs in at the message board.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_firewood.title: Firewood for the Lodge
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_firewood.wood.jo:
The storyteller asked: "Bundle some firewood against the night. Eight logs will do."
Open the board with logs in hand and they will be taken.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.day1_firewood.wood.wo: Hand logs in at the message board
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.done: The owner never arrived here. But the handwriting remained.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.follow:
Hollows of footprints lead away from beneath the fallen cart, one step at a time, straight toward somewhere.
Follow the hollows and look for the owner.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.summar: Look for the owner of the fallen cart and find the diary.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.tell.j: I read the diary. I should show it to the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.tell.t: Tell the storyteller about the diary
quest.skyabyss.ch1.lost_traveller.title: The Cart Owner
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.cave.jour:
The traveling artisan said: "I saw a broken sword. Deep in the Cleft Shell. ...When, I do not remember."
A damp wind comes from a crack in the hillside. Whatever waits at the bottom takes a shield head-on. Get behind it.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.cave.lead: The artisan: "I saw a broken sword. Deep in the Cleft Shell. Go and look."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.cave.swor: Find the broken sword in the Cleft Shell
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.done:
"A blade lightens as you hone it. ...Do not break this one."
For a shield, the storyteller knows a tale of the traveller long ago.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.forge.jou: The plinth said: "Swung it unhoned. So it broke." Make an iron sword at a workbench and hone it on a rock whetstone before you swing it. The whetstone is in your wayfarer's notes.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.forge.lea: The artisan: "Do not swing it unhoned. That sword broke because it was."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.forge.whe: Hone your blade on a rock whetstone
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.hear.jour:
Isana said: "Next, a blade. The traveling artisan said they saw a broken sword."
Ask the artisan about blades.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.hear.lead: Isana: "Next, a blade. The traveling artisan said they saw a broken sword."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.hear.talk: Ask the traveling artisan about blades
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.show.jour: The sword on the plinth crumbled when lifted. Only the way its grip was wrapped stays in your eye. Tell the traveling artisan.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.show.lead: The sword crumbled. Only the way its grip was wound stays with you.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.show.talk: Tell the artisan about the broken sword
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.summary: The second step in getting ready. Find the broken sword the artisan saw deep in the Cleft Shell, then make an iron sword and hone it.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_blade.title: The Broken Sword
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.armor.jour:
The page in the pack read: "Twenty-four iron. Breastplate and leggings first. The wind on the back cuts to the bone."
Iron ore smelts into iron in a furnace; the pit walls were streaked with it. Make a helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, and wear them.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.armor.lead: The page was written by a tidy hand: "Twenty-four iron. Breastplate and leggings first."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.armor.wear: Make and wear iron armor, as the page says
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.done:
"You smell of iron. ...That traveller must have stood under the chain like that."
Next, a blade. The traveling artisan said they saw a broken sword.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.pit.journa:
Isana said: "You cannot climb the chain bare-handed. The traveller who came here before wore iron."
The cairns from the north gate over the hills are that traveller's road. They end at an old mine called the Bone Pit. Something may be left there.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.pit.lead: Isana: "Iron first. Follow the road of the one before you. The cairns lead to the Bone Pit."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.pit.page: Follow the cairns to the pack in the Bone Pit
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.summary: The first step in getting ready for the whale. Follow the road of the traveller Isana spoke of to the Bone Pit, and wear iron.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_iron.title: The Iron Trail
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.done:
"A shield is not only for what is in front of you. ...Carry it for the way home, too."
Iron, blade and shield: you have them all now.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.pack.jou:
On the night of footsteps, the earlier traveller came back clutching a shield, a bundle of hardtack on their back. Three great claw marks crossed the shield.
A shield can be made at a workbench; road hardtack is in your wayfarer's notes. If you bring ward thread to the artisan, they will weave a heartbeat ward too (not required).
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.pack.lea: The storyteller: "Take a shield. Provisions too. If you mean to come back."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.summary: The last step in getting ready. Hear the storyteller's tale of the night of footsteps, then ready a shield and road hardtack.
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.tale.jou:
The artisan said the storyteller knows a tale about a shield and a traveller long ago.
The storyteller wants to tell it. "It is about the night of footsteps. Listen."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.tale.lea: The artisan: "The blade will do. For a shield, the storyteller knows a tale of the one before."
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.tale.tal: Hear the tale of the night of footsteps
quest.skyabyss.ch1.trail_shield.title: Shield and Provisions
sign.skyabyss.ch1_bone_pit.4: Who stays down, we do not count
sign.skyabyss.ch1_cold_door.1: The wind on the back is cold
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.1: A bone sentinel's shield turns almost every blow from the front. Circle round to its back.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.2: A bone archer draws before it shoots, and does not move while drawing. Stay behind a pillar, close in after it fires.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.3: Moss crawlers stay low and come at your feet. Do not put your back to a wall before you are surrounded.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.4: When a line or ring is marked on the floor, jump, run or take cover. Do not stand still.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.5: Strike the song stones from the lowest cairn up. In the cave, strike the ringing stones from the fewest candles up.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.6: Before going deep into the back, check your body, blade and provisions. You can go on without them. It will only be heavier.
wayfarer_notes.ch1.line.7: Shell scraps and bone chips make road gear, rock whetstones and road hardtack. Open these notes and the recipes appear at the workbench.
